name: IA Local — abrir painel de chat do Mestre IA

planSteps.description: Click the '🤖 IA Local' button in the top-right header
A modal titled '🧠 Mestre IA (Ollama)' appears and is visible
The modal contains the welcome message 'Sou o Mestre IA' and an input field
Click the ✕ button in the modal header
The modal closes and is no longer visible
